overall: The AG found a de minimis violation: the Board failed to ask whether others were recording and the chair failed to announce recordings before an executive session. No additional relief was ordered because the Board adopted a remedial policy and the complainant was not prevented from recording.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board denied him the chance to notify the chair he would record the Jan. 8, 2014 open session before it entered executive session.
allegations.key_passage: While we find that this procedural failure was a violation of the Open Meeting Law, the harm was de minimis as Mr. Kumar was not prevented from recording this open session meeting, and the public was informed of his recording after the Board returned from executive session.
